text: By checking this box and clicking "{cta}", I agree that {seller} (a licensed insurance agency) may contact me about {product_label} at the phone number and email I provided, including by calls and text messages that may use automated technology or prerecorded/artificial voice. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Message & data rates may apply. I can opt out anytime (reply STOP to texts). I also agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms.
email_only_text: Email me my results. I agree to receive emails from {brand} about my results and related insurance information. I can unsubscribe anytime.
notes: Checkbox is unchecked by default (no pre-checked consent).

{seller} is the PLATFORM phrase ('GS Allude and its licensed agent partner'), never a pre-chosen agency: consumers never see or select a buyer. The platform assigns the fulfilling agent after submit, from each buyer's contracted criteria, daily cap and prepaid balance — never from anything the browser sends.
Full rendered text, version, page URL, IP, user agent, timestamp and a SHA-256 of the form snapshot are stored per lead.

Opt-outs honored within 10 business days by any reasonable means (FCC); FL s.501.059: the 15-day STOP window is a pre-suit cure period, not the compliance standard; honor STOP within 10 business days (FCC).
text_es: Al marcar esta casilla y hacer clic en "{cta}", acepto que {seller} (una agencia de seguros con licencia) me contacte sobre {product_label} al número de teléfono y correo electrónico que proporcioné, incluso mediante llamadas y mensajes de texto que pueden usar tecnología automatizada o voz pregrabada/artificial. El consentimiento no es una condición de compra. Pueden aplicar tarifas de mensajes y datos. Puedo cancelar en cualquier momento (responde STOP a los textos). También acepto la Política de Privacidad y los Términos.
email_only_text_es: Envíenme mis resultados por correo. Acepto recibir correos de {brand} sobre mis resultados e información de seguros relacionada. Puedo darme de baja en cualquier momento.
